events.title: AI-Powered Software Delivery, Done Right
events.description: Ann Arbor AI/ML Meetup Everyone's adopting AI tools, but few are seeing real transformation, because tools alone don't change how work gets done. This talk introduces Forge, a structured approach that weaves AI into every stage of building software, from planning through launch, so gains are visible, trustworthy, and repeatable rather than a one-off speed boost. Expect real numbers: faster planning, faster development, more frequent releases, all tracked and proven along the way. A practical look at what it takes to make AI adoption actually pay off, for technical and business audiences alike. Speaker's Profile: Enterprise AI Leader at Autodesk with 25+ years of experience helping global organizations transform employee experience and software delivery through AI Search, RAG, GenAI, Agentic AI, and AI-powered engineering practices. I lead enterprise Generative AI strategy, building scalable, responsible AI platforms that deliver measurable business outcomes. Passionate about sharing practical insights on Enterprise AI Architecture, AI-powered software delivery, Agentic Systems, and Responsible GenAI based on real-world implementations. Pizzas and sodas will be provided by Ann Arbor SPARK to keep the energy up! Whether you're a student, researcher, software engineer, entrepreneur, mathematician, or simply curious about AI, everyone interested in machine learning and artificial intelligence is welcome. P.S. Stay connected between meetups on our Discord: [https://discord.gg/jc66nmmMGS](https://discord.gg/jc66nmmMGS)
